notes:
**Launch mode is much more reliable.** This release comes from a full review of Launch.

- **Agents run at your effort level.** Every agent now uses Settings → Agents → Default effort, or the effort you pick on its card. Before, most agents got no effort at all. Direct Claude Code and Codex get it as a command-line flag. Ollama models get the field Ollama actually reads (`reasoning_effort`), and a model that rejects it is retried without it.
- **The orchestrator hears every finish and every question**, not just an agent's first. After the automatic merge it acts on the result instead of re-reading transcripts.
- **Fewer false errors.** Line numbers, "403 modules" or a mention of "rate limits" no longer put a healthy agent into an error loop.
- **Committed work is safe.** A failed or stopped spawn no longer deletes a branch that holds earlier commits, and each chat's branches are now separate.
- **Merges take turns.** Auto-merge, the Merge button and the orchestrator no longer run `git merge` at the same time.
- **A broken stream is reported as a failure,** so Claude Code and Codex retry instead of accepting half an answer.
- **Codex keeps its full system prompt.** A model-catalog file had been silently removing it. Codex also waits up to 30 minutes for a slow thinking model's first output.
- **Claude Code stays on your model.** Its sub-agents and background calls use the launch's model, and it knows the model's real context window, so it compacts at the right time.
- **Permission instructions match your setting.** They now follow Settings → Launch → Auto-approve everything instead of contradicting each other.
- **Security:** the local Launch server now refuses requests from web pages and from rebound host names.
- **Windows:** "Install chatoss command" works.
- Also fixed: stopping an agent while it boots is a clean cancel, closing an agent stops it before its folder is removed, the Merge button no longer disappears after an auto-merge, and the Launch layout no longer shows on the Remix tab.

Includes the 1.27.1 startup-crash fix. If you're on 1.27.0, reinstall once: on macOS or Linux run `curl -fsSL https://chatoss.ai/install.sh | sh`, and on Windows run the installer below.

Download the installer for your platform below.

**macOS:** download the signed + notarized universal `ChatOSS_<version>_universal.dmg` — one build that runs natively on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs — built and uploaded from a developer machine with the Apple Developer ID certificate.
**Windows:** ChatOSS_*_x64-setup.exe
**Linux:** ChatOSS_*_amd64.AppImage or .deb
